blocks.text: Why digital marketing analysts prefer Chrome on Mac

Your Mac is built for performance and Chrome is the standard for web analytics. You likely spend hours in Google Analytics, Looker Studio, and various ad platforms. These tools are optimized for Chrome. Using Chrome on macOS 13 or later gives you access to the latest security patches and features. The browser handles complex data visualization better than alternatives.

You juggle email, Slack, and campaign reports. This creates digital debt that drains your energy. Lazur acts as your assistant to reduce this friction. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask Lazur to summarize a long email or draft a response. It does not click buttons for you, but it provides the information you need to stay on track.

blocks.title: Stay in the flow

blocks.text: How to use keyboard shortcuts effectively

Chrome relies on the Command key. You can create custom shortcuts in System Settings > Keyboard > Keyboard Shortcuts > App Shortcuts. This is useful for menu items you click often. If you need to know where a setting is located, ask Lazur. It will circle the area on your screen.
Privacy and security for marketing data

You handle sensitive client data. Keep your browser clean by blocking third-party cookies for specific sites. You can also block notifications to prevent interruptions during deep work. Lazur respects your privacy. It only looks at your screen when you hold the shortcut key.

Communication is a major part of your day. Whether you use Slack or Gmail, Lazur helps you draft messages. Hold fn to dictate text directly into your browser fields. It is faster than typing and helps you get your thoughts down before you forget them.

Start by organizing your workspace. Use [How to create a chrome profile on mac](/how-to/create-a-chrome-profile-in-chrome) to separate client work. Then, try using Lazur to ask for help with your next report. You will find that keeping your hands on the keyboard and your focus on the screen makes a difference.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me in Chrome?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points, guides, and answers questions. It does not perform clicks or navigate your browser for you.

faq.question: Is Lazur safe for my client data?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut. It does not store your audio or screenshots, and it does not use your data to train models.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on older Macs?
faq.answer: Lazur runs on macOS. It supports Apple silicon and Intel chips.
